# mooncake state

Read this machine's state (snapshot, facts, metrics)

## Description

Bare `state` prints the composite machine snapshot. `state facts` reports static host facts; `state metrics` samples live CPU/GPU/memory/load/network. All three honour --format json.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
| `--budget` | int | `0` | Approximate token budget for text output (0 = unlimited, 1 token ~ 4 chars) |
| `--diff` | string | - | Path to previous snapshot JSON file to diff against |
| `--save` | string | - | Save current snapshot to this file |

## Subcommands

- [facts](state_facts.md) — Display static host facts
- [metrics](state_metrics.md) — Display live system metrics (CPU/GPU/memory/load/network)
